第12章 狍子出现了-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

李青山将野兔是如何处理的，以及需要注意的地方，全部告诉大壮。

兔子处理完后，便直接丢给大壮。

二人一狗，继续沿着这条小溪流，小心翼翼的朝着下流的方向游走，寻觅猎物。

十分钟后！

李青山胸口的葫芦吊坠又是微微发热，这让李青山立刻警觉起来，连忙朝着大壮压了压手，缓缓朝着前方靠近。

果然。

前方一只野兔，正在品尝地上鲜嫩的青草，完全没有意识到威胁的来临。

“山哥，怎么又是野兔？”大壮望着再次出现的野兔，脸上满是懵逼之色道。

昨天打了三只，刚刚又打了一只，现在又出现一只？

难不成。

老林子里面只剩下野兔了不成？

“有野物就行！”

“一只野兔四毛多，咱们一天要是能打十只，那可就是四块多钱，能买四十斤大米。”

李青山舔了舔嘴唇道。

“大米啊？”

大壮暗自咽了口口水道：“山哥，我都好久没吃过大米饭了。”

“你小子什么时候吃过大米饭？”李青山笑着道。

“咦……好像是的，咱们好像只喝过大米汤，剩下的就是吃粗粮……娘的，这次打猎回去卖了钱，我大壮一定要买些大米回去做大米饭尝一尝。”

大壮脸上流露出一抹兴奋，不过很快又眉头紧皱，指着前方的野兔道：“不过，山哥……这野兔也太远了点，估计有七十米了吧？能射中吗？”

李青山这把弓的有效射程只有五十米，过了五十米后力量锐减。

之前。

李青山最多猎杀的是四十米的猎物，与七十米完全不是一个难度的。

光是从视觉上就不一样。

七十米肯定显得小，还要受到风速的影响，毕竟猎弓不是猎枪，受到风速的影响极其大，刚开始的时候老道士教自己测算风速和距离，后来就是凭借感觉出手，一切都在潜意识里。

“欻！”

大壮话音落下，李青山站起身来，直接猎弓满月，瞬间出手，长箭飞射而出，空中划过一道弧线，利用惯性力量稳稳的落在野兔的颈部。

射中。

大黄紧接着冲出去，将正在抽搐的野兔叼了回来。

“我……我滴娘嘞……神了，真神了啊……！”

“山哥，我感觉你比占山叔还要厉害啊！”

“这就射中了？”

“你瞄了吗？”

大壮望着七十米外的猎物倒地，整个人都被震的双目圆瞪，张大了嘴巴道。

在大壮的心中。

李青山的狩猎水平，已经超越了占山叔，石溪村第一猎人，也没问题了。

其实。

大壮忽略了一个点。

李青山狩猎到的野兔，全部都是命中颈部，最大保存皮毛的完好。

野兔的皮毛虽然不贵，但毕竟是一笔收入。

“兔子处理掉，咱们速度快点，清晨是猎物最多的时候，过了清晨就没什么机会了。”

李青山催促道。

“哎！”

大壮连忙点头，手起刀落，开始处理野物。

不过，大壮刚刚说得对。

怎么全是野兔子？

其他的野物一个都没见到，来一只野鸡换一换口味也行啊。

野兔处理好后，二人一狗继续上路。

刚走不过三分钟。

大黄似乎闻到了什么，转头咬了咬李青山的裤脚，便朝着前面一路小跑起来。

“有野物！”

李青山见状心中一喜，连忙带着大壮匆匆跟在大黄后面。

果然。

前方的灌木丛内，有两只野兔，每一只大概都有四斤重，这让李青山心中一喜。

算上这两只，今天一个早晨就狩猎到四只了。

不过，这次葫芦吊坠并没有反应。

想必是葫芦吊坠每次发热，就会为自己加持幸运，自然会有野物出现，但有时候不用加持幸运，也能够遇到野物，比如说这一次，就是大黄通过嗅地上的味道寻到的。

“山哥，两只野兔啊……！”

“可惜了，只能打一只，另外一只肯定要跑掉了。”

大壮望着前方的野兔，脸上流露出一抹可惜之色道。

“欻欻！！”

李青山拉满猎弓，长箭瞬间射出，空中两道箭影飞过，没入两只野兔的颈部。

两只野兔被钉死后，身体在地上不断抽搐着，动弹不得。

“我的娘嘞……！”

“两箭？”

大壮按捺不住内心的激动和震惊，瞬间站起身来，难以置信的朝着李青山望了过去，眼神中除了敬佩还是敬佩。

山哥这是怎么了？

一把弓一次射出两只箭？

Li Qingshan told Da Zhuang all about how to deal with hares and what needs to be paid attention to.

After handling the rabbit, he threw it directly to Da Zhuang.

The two of them and the dog continued to swim along the small stream, cautiously heading downstream, looking for prey.

Ten minutes later!

The gourd pendant on Li Qingshan's chest was slightly hot again, which made Li Qingshan immediately alert. He quickly pressed his hand towards Da Zhuang and slowly approached the front.

really.

A hare in front was tasting the fresh green grass on the ground, completely unaware of the approaching threat.

"Brother Shan, why is it a hare again?" Da Zhuang said with confusion on his face as he looked at the hare that appeared again.

Yesterday I shot three, and just now I shot another, and now another one appears?

Is it possible?

Are there only hares left in the old forest?

"As long as there are wild animals!"

"A hare costs more than four cents. If we can hunt ten of them a day, that's more than four yuan, which can buy forty kilograms of rice."

Li Qingshan licked his lips and said.

"Rice?"

Da Zhuang swallowed secretly and said: "Brother Shan, I haven't eaten rice in a long time."

"When have you ever eaten rice?" Li Qingshan said with a smile.

"Eh... It seems so. We only drank rice soup, and the rest was whole grains... Damn, I sold the money after going hunting this time. I must buy some rice and go back to make rice to try it."

There was a touch of excitement on Da Zhuang's face, but he soon frowned and pointed at the hare in front of him and said: "But Brother Shan... this hare is too far away. It is estimated to be seventy meters away? Can it be shot?"

The effective range of Li Qingshan's bow is only fifty meters, and its power drops sharply after fifty meters.

Before.

The most Li Qingshan hunted was prey that was forty meters away, which was not at the same level of difficulty as seventy meters.

Just visually it's different.

Seventy meters must seem small, and it is also affected by wind speed. After all, a hunting bow is not a hunting rifle, and it is greatly affected by wind speed. At the beginning, the old Taoist priest taught himself to measure wind speed and distance, and later he relied on feeling, everything was subconscious.

"Tian!"

After Da Zhuang's voice fell, Li Qingshan stood up and directly shot the bow full moon. He took action instantly, and the long arrow flew out, drew an arc in the air, and used the power of inertia to land steadily on the hare's neck.

shot.

Dahuang rushed out immediately and picked up the twitching hare.

"I...my mother...is amazing, so amazing...!"

"Brother Shan, I feel that you are even more powerful than Uncle Zhanshan!"

"Is this a hit?"

"Did you take aim?"

Da Zhuang looked at the prey falling to the ground seventy meters away, his eyes widened in shock, and his mouth opened wide.

In Da Zhuang's heart.

Li Qingshan's hunting level has surpassed Uncle Zhanshan, the number one hunter in Shixi Village, so there is no problem.

actually.

Da Zhuang ignored one point.

All the hares that Li Qingshan hunted were hit on the neck, and the fur was most intact.

Although hare fur is not expensive, it is an income after all.

"Get rid of the rabbits. Let's hurry up. Early in the morning is when there are the most prey. After early morning, there will be no chance."

Li Qingshan urged.

"Hey!"

Da Zhuang nodded quickly, raised his knife and started to deal with the wild animals.

However, Da Zhuang was right just now.

Why are they all wild rabbits?

I didn't see any other wild animals, so a pheasant would be nice for a change.

After the hare was taken care of, the two of them and the dog continued on their way.

Just walked for less than three minutes.

Dahuang seemed to smell something, turned around and bit Li Qingshan's trousers, and then trotted forward.

"There's wild animals!"

Li Qingshan was overjoyed when he saw this, and hurriedly followed Dahuang with Da Zhuang.

really.

In the bushes ahead, there were two hares, each weighing about four kilograms, which made Li Qingshan feel happy.

Counting these two, we hunted four this morning.

However, this time the gourd pendant did not respond.

It must be that every time the gourd pendant gets hot, it will bless you with luck, and wild animals will naturally appear. But sometimes you can encounter wild animals without blessing luck. For example, this time, Rhubarb found it by smelling the smell on the ground.

"Brother Shan, there are two hares...!"

"It's a pity that I can only fight one, and the other one will definitely run away."

Da Zhuang looked at the hare in front of him with a look of pity on his face.

"Tiantan!!"

Li Qingshan fully drew his hunting bow, and the long arrow shot out instantly. Two arrow shadows flew through the air and sank into the necks of two hares.

After the two hares were crucified, their bodies continued to twitch on the ground, unable to move.

"My mother...!"

"Two arrows?"

Da Zhuang couldn't suppress the excitement and shock in his heart, and stood up instantly, looking at Li Qingshan in disbelief, with admiration and admiration in his eyes.

Brother Shan, what's going on?

A bow that shoots two arrows at once?
